review_redaction.purpose: Reviewer-facing derived copy (decision D-EXPORT-03), not the frozen file. Observed fields (outcomes of probes, smokes and pilots, token counts, real costs, real-run dates, corrections about earlier reports, paths under runs/) are removed; every settings field is unchanged.
review_redaction.hashes_note: Hashes recorded in this file refer to the original files, which are not distributed; they do not match the derived copies.

what_changed_from_v1: huggingface_reasoning_control is no longer null: the pilot sends no reasoning parameter, as an explicit decision rather than an unfilled field.

gateway.name: huggingface_router
gateway.credential_note: HF_TOKEN only. OPENROUTER_API_KEY is never accepted on this route.

model_entry.selection_status_note: Confirmed so the 192-call pilot can run. This is not approval for the full scope; see status.route_selection. The experiment definition that carries this entry declares no full scope at all, so a full manifest cannot be generated from it.

recorded_per_call.requested_provider: the provider pinned in the model id
recorded_per_call.api_model_returned: what the response said the model was
recorded_per_call.upstream_provider: read from the body if present, otherwise from the header
recorded_per_call.cost_reported: true when the provider stated one
recorded_per_call.cost_is_provider_estimate: true on this route; OpenRouter's credited cost sets it false
recorded_per_call.cost_estimated: computed locally from the tariff snapshot, kept beside the provider figure so the two can be compared
recorded_per_call.cached_input_tokens: usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens; null means not reported, never zero

relationship_to_the_openrouter_route.reason: Baidu does not serve this model on Hugging Face, so the two routes cannot reach the same backend. A shared payload digest makes the two comparable, never interchangeable.
relationship_to_the_openrouter_route.comparison_that_is_permitted: Descriptive, payload-matched, reported side by side and never merged.
